# Community Health File

## Welcome!

Thank you for visiting Agentic Security Demos! We're building educational materials for teaching agentic AI security concepts, and we'd love your help.

## Getting Started

- 📖 **Read the [README](README.md)** - Quick start, demos overview, and structure
- 🛡️ **Review [RESPONSIBLE_USE.md](RESPONSIBLE_USE.md)** - Mandatory safety rules
- 🤝 **Read [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)** - Our community standards
- 🤝 **Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)** - How to contribute

## Ways to Contribute

### 🐛 Report Bugs
Use our [Bug Report template](.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml) - include reproduction steps and environment details.

### ✨ Request Features
Use our [Feature Request template](.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.yml) - describe educational value and safety considerations.

### 📚 Improve Documentation
Use our [Documentation template](.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/documentation.yml) - help us clarify explanations.

### 💻 Submit Code
- Fork → Branch → Commit → PR
- Run `make test` and `make verify-safety` before submitting
- Follow our [PR Template](.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md)

## Community Channels

- 💬 **GitHub Discussions** - Questions, ideas, show-and-tell
- 🐛 **GitHub Issues** - Bugs, features, docs improvements
- 📧 **Email** - maintainers@agentic-security-demos.example (placeholder)

## Recognition

Contributors are recognized in:
- GitHub Contributors graph
- Release notes
- Hall of Fame (coming soon)

## Getting Help

- 📚 **Documentation** - [docs/](docs/) and demo READMEs
- ❓ **FAQ** - [SUPPORT.md](SUPPORT.md)
- 💬 **Discussions** - Ask questions, share ideas
- 🐛 **Issues** - Bug reports and feature requests

## Safety First

**All contributions must maintain our safety guarantees:**
- Zero network access in tests/demos
- No real credentials or API keys
- Synthetic fixtures only
- Clear safety notices

See [RESPONSIBLE_USE.md](RESPONSIBLE_USE.md) and [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for details.

## Recognition Program

| Contribution Type | Recognition |
|-------------------|-------------|
| Bug fixes | Contributors graph, release notes |
| New exercises | Demo README credits |
| New demos | Demo author credit, blog post |
| Documentation | Docs contributors list |
| Safety improvements | Security hall of fame |

## Response Times

- **Bug reports**: Initial response within 48 hours
- **Feature requests**: Initial response within 1 week
- **Security issues**: Acknowledgment within 48 hours (private)
- **Documentation**: Initial response within 1 week
